cases.title: Edit Pipe on P3 with the question after the save still asks, still updates 4 pipes and 3 pits downstream, and one U takes back the edit and the cascade together
cases.plan_item: C-79b1 area test plan item 15 (#1972, BUG-658)
cases.expected: Select pipe P3 (10A98D), CDEDIT, Y to the older-version question, first invert 17.60, second 17.50, Edit pipe, Save; the box 'Recalculate downstream inverts' still appears and is answered Yes; Cascade Preview Apply shows '[CDEDIT-CASCADE] Updated 4 pipes and 3 pits from P3 (IL 17.50). Min grade: 1:16.'; the invert texts read exactly R11v87's after-cascade set; neither '[CE] The downstream levels were not recalculated' nor '[CE] Pipe updated. The downstream recalculation could not be completed' is shown; one U echoes CDEDIT and every invert text and the object count read as before the edit.
cases.why_not_unit: The held-back question is asked from a live Edit Pipe save after a real drawing commit; only a live drawing shows the cascade still runs and that AutoCAD's undo stack holds the edit and the cascade as one step.
not_automated: SEEN by Codex (the point of BUG-658): when the Recalculate box appears, the drawing behind it ALREADY shows P3's new levels 17.60 and 17.50 (before the fix the box came first). With the switch false and AutoCAD restarted, the box comes before the drawing changes.

SEEN by Codex: a save that is refused (the PR names a locked label layer; any refusal that rolls Edit Pipe back) asks no question, shows no '[CDEDIT-CASCADE] Updated' line and changes nothing downstream. Whether a locked label layer refuses the save on this build is UNSURE (CE's locked-layer rules mostly skip and say so); Codex must find a refusal that really rolls back.

The 'reopen the drawing, then run CDPROPAGATE from pit ...' line (fx72) needs a save that commits but needs a reopen; no robot route makes that. REDO is not driven (R11v87 covers it on the old order).
